commit_message: Enable AI Studio visual validation scenario
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0143 model resource controls
pr_body:
## Summary

- implement truthful provider-independent model resource operations and telemetry provenance
- add Ollama-compatible `/api/ps` telemetry plus verified unload, reload, and CPU offload transitions
- reclaim supported model residency before Interrupt-for-Editing restore and managed Play
- expose measured model-resource posture in AI Studio without fabricating device-wide free VRAM
- add deterministic adapter contract tests and accept ADR 0143
- add a visual-validation-only AI Studio launch scenario so the changed UI can be captured and inspected

## Validation

Use normal Windows Validation. AI Studio resource posture presentation changed, so Visual Validation is required in addition to Rust validation.
